messages.author: e46cb5dd353b7dfb
messages.subject: Re: Same result at different food levels
parts:
Hi again Martin - it will depend on X and K - read about the concept of the functional response in the DEB book. There's a transition between food intake being limited by searching to being limited by processing. After you reach the latter, it doesn't matter how much more food you give the animal - it's not going to change the metabolic dynamics because it's limited by the maximum assimilation rate.

All the best,
Mike
